top_signals.title: How Trump May Try to Further Isolate Iran’s Economy
top_signals.summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent vowed to ramp up pressure on Iran by targeting its economic partners, saying "You are either with us, or against us". But as Bloomberg's Stuart Livingstone-Wallace explains, his realistic options to further isolate Iran's economy may be limited. (Source: Bloomberg)
